morbi.headline: Morbi gets energy cost relief and Gulf exports resume amid weak overall outlook.
what_changed: Morbi's ceramic industry received a ₹5 discount on natural gas prices, bringing rates down from ₹82.
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed, though overall export demand remains weak.
Kajaria Ceramics reported a beat on sales and profit for Q2 2026.
stress_signals: Overall export outlook for the Morbi ceramic cluster remains weak despite the resumption of Gulf shipments [c2b4a2f5422a].
A large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC, Morbi [f675c060fa53].
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices for the Morbi ceramic industry were discounted by ₹5, dropping from ₹82 [279312659941].
Shipments to the Gulf have officially resumed for Morbi ceramic exporters [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Sustained shipment volumes and freight trends for Gulf export destinations.
Effective dates and full pricing structures of the ₹5 natural gas price discount.
Account-level capacity utilization and operational status of units in Rafaleshwar GIDC following coal seizures.

surat.headline: Severe textile payment delays and diamond export contractions offset festive recoveries and PLI easing.
what_changed: Textile weavers staged protests and escalated disputes to police as payment dues exceeded 200 days ahead of Diwali.
Textile mills faced operational pressures from electricity tariff hikes, power cuts, and fire damage in Pandesara.
Textile PLI eligibility threshold was slashed by 50% with an extension to FY34, while trade exhibitions opened in Sarsana.
Diamond and apparel exporters confronted factory shutdowns from a US demand slump, despite reported pre-Diwali demand uptick.
stress_signals: Weavers staged protests over payment dues crossing 200 days [774ba602b06e], with payment disputes escalating to police stations [80f44f3f370f].
Textile mills hit by operational headwinds including power cuts and electricity tariff increases [385f9b90ae46], along with a ₹1 crore fire loss in Pandesara [dba1533f8fd5].
A Surat textile mill owner suffered a ₹1.69 crore fraud via broker default [25d6a0f6dbec], and textile units brace for fresh labor unrest [d1fffb80f879].
US demand slump triggered factory closures for diamond and apparel exporters [caa34a6cf84e], alongside regional rough shortages closing 800 offices in nearby Bhavnagar [f374a30b31ac].
improvement_signals: Traders across Global, Bombay, and Ring Road markets successfully recovered ₹6 crore in stuck mercantile payments for 70 traders [a523a4bf860d].
Textile PLI scheme turnover threshold reduced by 50% and scheme tenure extended to FY 2033-34 [64c35d822d81].
Surat diamond units witnessed revival from global festive demand [01cb30b63e0d], supported by the launch of ICA GemLab testing facilities [4b0e420193b2].
what_to_watch: Debtor velocity and debtor aging beyond 180-200 days in weaving and trading accounts vulnerable to broker-driven defaults.
Electricity utility bills and power curtailment impact on capacity utilization and mill operating margins.
Export realization cycles and order book cancellations among US-facing diamond cutting and apparel units.
Outcomes and new order bookings emerging from Textile Week-1 at Sarsana and India ITME 2026.
